set.body:
Outcome: one blind double-coding rubric covering scene (narrative/referent), detail atoms and kinds, graded fidelity and row coverage, plus a timing pilot that sets the coding budget. Serves preview delivery 5 and DL1-DL4 so coders are recruited once.
Scope: rubric text, a coding sheet generated from bundles, pilot on seen/throwaway material only. Coders do not see model answers; disagreements kept before adjudication. Owner's 50 claim-check items calibrate the rubric and are not a test.
Acceptance: rubric written and reviewed; pilot run with recorded minutes per unit and per atom; budget proposal for the owner. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md#human-reference.
set.title: [detail-mapping] Joint blind coding rubric and timing pilot (preview delivery 5 + DL1-DL4)
